name: m5stack-preview
description: Build and test M5Stack device apps with Codex using a local emulator, browser microphone, app-owned audio and optional networking. Deploy portable app source to supported physical boards.

interface.longDescription: A community plugin for developing M5Stack apps with Codex. Five native emulator profiles, Chrome microphone input, supported speaker/buzzer output and optional HTTP(S). Three tested physical deployment targets. First-release host validation covers macOS Apple Silicon and Chrome. No base API key or transcription service. This simulates supported app interfaces, not arbitrary ESP32 firmware or every peripheral.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me build my own M5Stack app. Start by asking what I want to make.
